resources.string: Loads live streams through a third-party proxy without ads, which sees your IP address and the channels you watch.
Blocks the video, audio and display ads Twitch requests itself.
Ignores the ad breaks and ad tracking Twitch announces during a stream.
Adds Reseam Settings above Account in Twitch\'s settings.
Shows Twitch\'s staff tools, such as the debug menu and the video debug panel.
Stops Twitch from crashing right after you log in.
Opens Twitch on Browse or Profile, and unlocks the Default Home Page setting.
Stops comScore, Nielsen, Sentry, Crashlytics, Sprig and Branch.
